# 风扇与压气机

_Fans & Compressors_

风扇与压气机通过转子对气流做功，使气流的总压升高。速度三角形、级的能量交换和部件特性图，是进一步理解设计与稳定工作范围的入口。

_Fans and compressors transfer work from rotating blades to the airflow, raising its total pressure. Velocity triangles, stage energy exchange and performance maps provide the next steps toward understanding design and stable operation._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 先认识转子、静子和级，再读轴向速度、圆周速度及相对速度。

_Identify rotors, stators and stages before studying axial, peripheral and relative velocities._

- 学习特性图的坐标和修正量，注明不同文献采用的定义。

_Check map coordinates and corrected quantities, because definitions may differ between references._

- 将失速、喘振等稳定性问题与整机匹配和控制保护关联。

_Connect stall and surge to whole-engine matching and control protection._
